title: Campaign expiry
brief: End the FreshSip campaign automatically at the end date and remove banners and prices everywhere.
clarifications: Which caches (CDN, app, search) hold campaign content?
What happens to carts that already hold promotional items at expiry?

requirements.title: Exact end
criteria: The offer stops being honoured at the end instant, converted explicitly to UTC, including across a DST transition.
Checkout re-validates the offer at order time, regardless of quote age.

requirements.title: Cache invalidation
criteria: Banner and price caches are invalidated within the agreed TTL after expiry.
Stale cached content cannot grant the offer.

test_plan: Boundary instants one second before and after the end
Checkout with a quote created before expiry
Cache TTL expiry and purge verification
risks: Honouring an expired offer from a stale cache
implementation_note: Template and preview only. These are not implemented end to end in this prototype.
